FROM python:3.10

# Install git and pytest
RUN apt-get update \
  && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git \
  && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
  && pip install pytest

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/crytic/slither.git /slither
RUN mkdir /repo
RUN git config --global --add safe.directory /repo
RUN cp -r /slither/. /repo && rm -rf /slither/
RUN rm -rf /slither

WORKDIR /repo

# Install the project and its runtime dependencies
RUN pip install -e .

# Install test dependencies
RUN pip install pytest-cov pytest-xdist deepdiff numpy coverage filelock pytest-insta

# Install a compatible Vyper compiler version (used by the e2e vyper tests)
RUN pip install 'vyper==0.3.10'

CMD ["/bin/bash"]
